Hi. My wife and I are in process of the final Visa interview, been married for a year. One of the pages in the AS6 form we were asked to fill has a page that needs signatures from the apartment owner that we’re renting, and it needs a confirmation from a lawyer as well. Today we went to the Magistrate’s office to sign all the affidavits but they refused this one because the guy wasn’t with us.
I think it’s major hassle to bring the person in live to there, or either to bring a lawyer to his house.. he just owns an apartment he was not involved in any way in our process.. is that something PIBA will have issues with?
Also there was a page that requires the mayor’s (!!) signature and the municipality just plainly refused to sign saying they don’t have “qualified personnel” to verify that we live in the city. Hopefully we wont have issues but our appointment is at Sunday.
